reason: As someone who hears pharmacies complain about rates every year, I am much more inclined to listen to Document A because it is completely honest about what it doesn't know regarding brand-name cross-subsidies and pharmacy closures, whereas Document B makes unsupported claims that none of the pharmacies make all the loss back and that all 3,100 of Reilly's prescriptions were for those 20 generics. Both effectively address my assumption about chain pharmacy access with the 20-mile figure and offer to share invoices, making Document A's superior credibility the deciding factor.
